parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paged query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: RegistryNameLike
parameters.description: The image repository name. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: RegistryTypeInList
parameters.description: The list of image repository types to include.

parameters.name: RegistryTypeNotInList
parameters.description: The list of image repository types to exclude.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.
